concerns.text: Task T009 (Factorial experiment driver) is scheduled before Task T010 (Assumption diagnostics & robust fallback). T010 modifies `code/analysis.py` to add assumption checks and automatic robust‑test fallback, which the factorial driver relies on when executing statistical tests. Running T009 before T010 means the pipeline would use the pre‑fallback version of `analysis.py`, violating the producer‑before‑consumer dependency.
